FAQ
What is IPO Prime?

IPO Prime is a global asset subscription platform launched by Bitget, focusing on investment opportunities in the pre-listing and initial public offering stages of companies. Eligible users can participate using supported stablecoins without opening a separate overseas brokerage account. The platform includes two sections: Pre-IPO and IPO:

  • Pre-IPO: Participate before the company goes public. Pre-tokens are delivered. Holding pre-tokens represents a debt instrument from the issuer to the holder, designed to reflect the company's performance;

  • IPO: Participate during the company's official IPO issuance stage. Settlement is based on the official issue price, and allocated assets are delivered as rTokens backed by real stocks.

What is the difference between IPO subscription on Bitget IPO Prime and traditional brokerage subscription?

IPO Prime integrates IPO subscriptions into your crypto account, offering a more convenient and flexible way to participate:

  • Direct participation with stablecoins: Subscribe using your Bitget account and supported stablecoins without opening a separate overseas brokerage account, reducing account opening and cross-platform fund transfer steps.

  • Participate with small amounts: Supports fractional share allocation, eliminating the need to prepare funds for whole shares, allowing you to flexibly arrange your investment according to your needs.

  • Access to institutional-grade IPO allocation channels: Connects with top global funds/family offices through a professional institutional allocation network, providing eligible investors with an institutional-grade participation path distinct from traditional retail subscription models.

Allocated assets are delivered as rTokens backed by real stocks. Once credited and open for trading, they can be held or traded directly on Bitget. Specific participation eligibility, allocation results, and delivery arrangements are subject to official announcements.

When will the final IPO issue price be confirmed?

It is usually announced after confirmation by the underwriters on the IPO pricing date. Bitget will update the project page simultaneously after obtaining the confirmation information. The specific time is subject to the confirmation progress between the issuer and the institutions. The estimated price does not constitute a final pricing commitment.

Note: When you submit your investment, the final IPO issue price may not yet be determined, so the page provides an estimated issue price for reference. The final issue price is determined by the issuer and underwriters based on subscription demand, market conditions, valuation, and other factors, and may be higher or lower than the estimated price. Bitget does not determine the final issue price, and subscriptions will be settled based on the official issue price and applicable fees.

What are the allocation rules?
Bitget will calculate the allocated amount based on the actual stock quota obtained for the corresponding project or round, according to the pre-announced allocation rules and the user's valid investment. The specific rules will be displayed on the subscription page.
Popular projects may experience oversubscription, and the invested amount does not equal the final allocated amount. Bitget does not guarantee full allocation or a fixed allocation rate.
How are unallocated funds handled?

During allocation settlement, the platform will only deduct the amount required for the actual allocation and the corresponding underwriting service fee. The remaining unused funds will be unfrozen and returned according to the rules after the allocation ends.

*Underwriting service fee: The underwriting service fee is a subscription-related service fee charged by project partner funds, brokerages, or allocation channels. The specific fee rate and calculation method will be displayed before submitting the commitment. This fee is only charged on the actual allocated portion, is already included in the committed amount, and requires no additional payment.

When will the allocation results be confirmed? When will the assets be delivered?
After the final issuance price and channel quota are determined, the platform will complete the allocation calculation and announce the users' allocation results. Allocation confirmation and asset delivery are different stages; rTokens will be distributed according to the delivery schedule announced in advance by the project. The delivery time for different projects or rounds may vary, and the actual progress may also be affected by brokerage settlement, custody, and system processing.
What are the differences between different subscription rounds for the same project? Can I participate in them simultaneously?
Eligibility, investment limits, fees, allocation rules, and delivery times may vary across different rounds. Please refer to the subscription page for details. Eligible users can participate in multiple subscription rounds simultaneously.

- Issuance change risk: The IPO may be delayed, suspended, or canceled due to market, regulatory, or issuance arrangements. In such cases, Bitget will process subscriptions according to the applicable product terms and release the corresponding frozen funds; specific processing methods and times are subject to the product terms and notifications.
- Allocation and delivery risk: Submitting a subscription does not guarantee an allocation or a full allocation. Asset delivery may be delayed due to issuance arrangements, settlement processes, or third-party channel processing progress, and users may be unable to trade at the expected time.
- Price and liquidity risk: The price after the IPO listing may fluctuate significantly, and may even fall below the issue price and the subscription cost including fees. The relevant assets may also experience insufficient liquidity, trading suspensions, or the inability to sell in a timely manner, and users may lose part or all of their investment principal.

The price of the relevant assets may also deviate from the underlying stock price. Specific rights and redemption arrangements are subject to the product terms.

A stablecoin is a type of cryptocurrency designed to maintain a steady value, typically pegged 1:1 to a traditional currency like the US dollar or British pound. Unlike most cryptocurrencies, stablecoins aim to avoid large price swings, making them useful for storing value on-chain.

How are Stablecoin Rewards different from bank savings interest?
While both let you earn a return on your holdings, they work differently. Bank savings interest is paid by a bank that lends out your deposited funds. Stablecoin Rewards are generated through the economics of each stablecoin's ecosystem — such as reserve yields or protocol mechanisms — and are distributed to eligible holders on Kraken. Your stablecoins are not lent out, and rewards are paid in the same stablecoin you hold. Stablecoin Rewards are not bank deposits and are not covered by deposit insurance programs such as FDIC or FSCS.

Trade and hold positions on designated USD1 RWA perpetual pairs on Aster to earn USD1 and $WLFI rewards. The campaign features two independent reward pools: Trading Points share the USD1 reward pool while Open Interest (OI) Points share the $WLFI reward pool. Rewards are calculated weekly (per epoch) based on your share of total points in each reward pool.

Important Updates

Starting from Epoch 9 (October 26, 2026, 00:00 UTC), Hidden Positions will no longer be eligible for OI Points in the USD1 RWA Boost campaign.

Phase1

The campaign will run from August 31 to December 31, 2026. Each epoch runs for one week, from Monday 00:00 to Sunday 23:59, except for the final epoch, which ends on December 31. The total rewards for Phase 1 are 125M $WLFI and 6.25M USD1, distributed equally across all epochs.

What are points?

Points are the scoring units of this campaign, earned by generating trading volume and holding positions on eligible pairs.

Trading Points are earned from eligible Taker Volume on eligible pairs, adjusted by a daily Multiplier based on your OI-to-Volume ratio.

Open Interest (OI) Points are earned based on your open position size on eligible pairs, captured via snapshots every 5 minutes and accrued over time.

Both points are updated daily.

Eligible pairs: SPCX/USD1, CL/USD1, XAU/USD1, SNDK/USD1, SKHYNIX/USD1, MU/USD1, GPRO/USD1 (subject to change — refer to the campaign page for the updated list).

USD1 Requirements

Multi-Asset Mode: To earn Trading Points and OI Points, USD1 must make up more than 50% of your Perpetual account balance during each snapshot. If the ratio is 50% or below, you will not earn any points for that snapshot.

Single-Asset Mode: A position using USD1 as collateral is treated as having a 100% USD1 collateral ratio and is eligible to earn Trading Points and OI Points. Positions using other assets as collateral are not eligible.

Eligibility is assessed using snapshots taken every 5 minutes. If you switch between Multi-Asset Mode and Single-Asset Mode, each snapshot is assessed based on the mode and USD1 collateral ratio at that time.

Grid Bot Accounts (live on 21 September, 2026)

Each Grid strategy runs in its own dedicated Grid Bot account. When you create a Grid strategy, the initial margin is transferred from your Perpetual Account to that Grid Bot account.

This transfer may affect the USD1 balance ratio of your Perpetual Account. If you are participating in the USD1 RWA Boost under Multi-Asset Mode, make sure your Perpetual Account continues to maintain a USD1 balance ratio above 50% after the transfer.

Each Grid Bot account is evaluated independently for the USD1 Requirement. If you run multiple Grid strategies, each corresponding Grid Bot account must independently maintain a USD1 balance ratio above 50% under Multi-Asset Mode to earn campaign points.

Trading Points and OI Points are calculated separately for each Grid Bot account and aggregated to the main account for campaign rewards.

Note: The USD1 Requirement does not affect how your 24h Average OI or Multiplier is calculated. It only determines whether the Taker Volume in a given 5-minute window counts as Eligible Taker Volume for Trading Points.

Note: Eligibility is determined separately for each account based on its own USD1 balance ratio. Regular subaccounts and Grid Bot accounts are evaluated independently.

Scoring Model

1. Trading Points

Trading Points are calculated using a daily Multiplier that reflects the ratio of your average open interest to your taker trading volume. This mechanism is designed to reward genuine trading activity and discourage wash trading or volume inflation without corresponding position-holding. Trading Points are calculated separately for each eligible trading pair. Your final Trading Points for the day are the sum of Trading Points earned across all eligible trading pairs

Formula

Trading Points = Eligible Taker Volume × Multiplier (calculated independently per pair)

Multiplier = 0.1 + 0.9 × min(1, 5 × R)²

R = 24h Average OI ÷ 24h Taker Volume

Multiplier & R — Daily Cycle: 00:00 UTC to 23:59 UTC

Both the Multiplier and Trading Points are calculated independently for each trading pair. Trading activity, OI, and volume from different trading pairs are not aggregated when determining a pair’s Multiplier.

For example, activity on XAUUSD1 will not affect the Multiplier or Trading Points calculation for CLUSD1.

Note: Starting from Epoch 5, OI in Hedge Mode will be calculated using your net position on each eligible trading pair. This affects OI Points and may also affect your Trading Points multiplier through the 24h average OI calculation.

24h Average OI

  • Your open interest (OI) is snapshotted every 5 minutes — 288 times per day.

  • 24h Average OI = Sum of all 288 OI snapshots ÷ 288

  • It is calculated independently for each trading pair

  • Your Multiplier is based on your full-day activity and is not affected by the USD1 Requirement. The USD1 Requirement only determines which Taker Volume is eligible for points.

How Trading Points Accumulate

Your Multiplier is fixed for the day, while Trading Points are calculated in 5-minute intervals:

  • Every 5 minutes, the system checks whether you meet the USD1 Requirement.

  • If yes, Taker Volume during that interval counts as Eligible Taker Volume.

  • If not, Taker Volume during that interval does not earn points.

Starting or stopping a Grid strategy may change the balance and USD1 ratio of the affected accounts. Campaign eligibility continues to be assessed independently at each 5-minute snapshot.

Example

David’s 24h Average OI (XAUUSD1) = $200,000 David’s 24h Taker Volume (XAUUSD1) = $1,000,000

R (XAUUSD1) = 200,000 ÷ 1,000,000 = 0.2 Multiplier (XAUUSD1) = 1.0

David’s 24h Average OI (CLUSD1) = $0 David’s 24h Taker Volume (CLUSD1) = $1,000,000

R (CLUSD1) = 0 Multiplier (CLUSD1) = 0.1

Scenario 1: David meets the USD1 Requirement for the full 24 hours

Eligible Taker Volume (XAUUSD1) = $1,000,000 Trading Points (XAUUSD1) = $1,000,000 × 1.0 = 1,000,000

Eligible Taker Volume (CLUSD1) = $1,000,000 Trading Points (CLUSD1) = $1,000,000 × 0.1 = 100,000

Trading Points = 1,000,000 + 100,000 = 1,100,000

Scenario 2: David meets the USD1 Requirement for only 1 hour, with $50,000 Taker Volume during that hour

Eligible Taker Volume (XAUUSD1) = $50,000 Trading Points (XAUUSD1) = $50,000 × 1.0 = 50,000

Eligible Taker Volume (CLUSD1) = $50,000 Trading Points(CLUSD1) = $50,000 × 0.1 = 5,000

Trading Points = 500,000 + 5,000 = 55,000

Scenario 3: David does not meet the USD1 Requirement at all

Eligible Taker Volume (XAUUSD1) = $0 Trading Points (XAUUSD1) = 0

Eligible Taker Volume (CLUSD1) = $0 Trading Points (CLUSD1) = 0

Trading Points = 0 + 0 = 0

2. Open Interest (OI) Points

OI Points are based on your position's notional value and how long you hold it. Snapshots are taken every 5 minutes (12 times per hour, 288 times per day) and summed directly — the longer and larger your position, the more OI Points you accumulate.

Example: David holds a $1,000,000 position continuously (Multi-Asset mode, USD1 balance requirement met):

Partial-hour example: if David closes the position at the 30-minute mark, approximately 6 snapshots are captured → roughly half the hourly points.

3. Single Asset Mode 2× Boost

Holding USD1-pair positions in Single Asset Mode earns 2× OI Points. Snapshots are taken every 5 minutes; the multiplier applied to each snapshot is determined by your account mode at the moment of that snapshot. If you are in Single Asset Mode at the time of a snapshot, that full snapshot interval counts at 2×. The longer you remain in Single Asset Mode, the greater your boost.

Note: Snapshot timing includes a randomised offset and is not disclosed publicly to prevent snapshot gaming.

Reward Allocation and Distribution

For each epoch, rewards are allocated based on each participant’s share of total eligible points in the corresponding reward pool:

Your reward for the epoch = Epoch reward pool × (Your points ÷ Total eligible points for the epoch)

Each epoch runs from Monday 00:00:00 to Sunday 23:59:59 UTC, except for the final epoch, which ends on December 31, 2026 at 23:59:59 UTC.

The Lighter Points Program on the Robinhood Chain is a way to recognize eligible users for participating in the trading platform and reward them for the value they bring.

Points are calculated and awarded in real time based on eligible activity, with an additional weekly points drop every Friday (first weekly drop on Fri Aug 21). The way points are calculated may change over time as we continue improving the program and rewarding meaningful participation while keeping things fair for everyone.

Live & Weekly Points

The live points are distributed in real time based on factors like volume, positions held, fees paid, using assets other than USDG as collateral, and others. Most markets have the same weight.

Weekly points are based on the activity from the previous Friday (incl.) to Thursday (incl.), are distributed every Friday, and are fine-tuned depending on the week’s activity.

For both point types, standard-to-standard activity is not rewarded.

Boosts

There are several ways for a user to boost their points. Some apply to both live and weekly points; others apply only to weekly points.

Robinhood Wallet Mobile boost

The mobile boost is linear and ranges from 1x for a user with only non-RH wallet mobile app volume to 2x for a user with only RH wallet volume. The volume is considered coming from the plaftorm that the order was placed from.

The boost influences both live and weekly points.

Referral boost

If you refer a trader, you get 10% of their points (live + weekly).

Referred traders get a 10% boost for their weekly points.

Market boosts

Some markets generate more points than others. Some do so for live points, some for the weekly, some for both.

A notable current boost is the earnings boost for weekly points: if an RWA market is tied to a company that does its earnings call in the interval the weekly points are calculated for, that market is boosted.

Pre IPO markets and new listings may also get boosts.

Hedge boost

The hedge boost allows traders to hedge (some of) their Lighter RH positions on Lighter Core and get more points for it.

For each market present on both venues, the 2.5x boost only applies to one pair of directions (e.g. long Core, short RH) out of the two.

Event Rules

Eligibility

  • • A new user is defined as a user who registers during the event period, or whose total deposit amount (including on-chain, fiat, and P2P deposits) was less than $100 prior to the event start date.
  • • Participants must click the "Register Now" button on the event page to be eligible for the event.
  • • Each user may only participate in one Airdrop+ event at a time. If a user has registered for Event A, they must wait until that event has ended before joining another Airdrop+ event. Event periods must not overlap.
  • • Market makers, institutional users, and certain affiliates and their referees are not eligible to participate in this event or claim any related rewards.
  • • The system will automatically calculate each participant's total deposit amount and trading volume. For users who register before the event begins, the tracking period will be from the event start date to the end date. For users who register after the event has started, the tracking period will be from the time of registration to the end of the event. Deposits and trades made before registration will not be included in the event statistics, but will not affect eligibility or reward distribution.

New User Task

  • • Participants must complete Advanced KYC Verification to be eligible for rewards.
  • • There are no restrictions on deposit crypto. Users may deposit any token, which will be converted into USDT value based on the platform's prevailing price at the time of deposit for reward calculation purposes. All deposits for this event are calculated as net deposits, using the formula: Net Deposit Amount = Total Deposits – Total Withdrawals. Deposit amounts are calculated based on the token value at the time of deposit, while withdrawal amounts are based on the token value at the time of withdrawal. Participants whose net deposit amount is below the minimum requirement at the end of the event will not be eligible for rewards.
  • • Eligible deposit methods include P2P, fiat deposits, and on-chain transfers. Eligible withdrawal methods include on-chain withdrawals, internal transfers, P2P or fiat withdrawals, and gift withdrawals.
  • • Spot trading volume includes transactions in USDT, USDC, USDE, and USD1 trading pairs, as well as Convert transactions. Valid Futures trading volume includes the participant's total trading volume (open positions + close positions) in USDT-M, USDC-M, and USDE-M perpetual Futures, as well as copy trading and grid trading volume. Only trading volume that incurs non-zero fees during the event period will be counted. Trading volume that uses fee vouchers will not be included.

Spot Trading Challenge

  • • Participants must complete at least Primary KYC Verification before the event ends to qualify for rewards.
  • • Spot trading volume calculations include trades made in USDT, USDC, USDE, USD1, and Convert trades.
  • • Trading volume calculation rules may vary across different events. For specific details, please refer to the rules on the respective event page.
  • • Tokens labeled with "0 Fees" are eligible for zero Spot trading fees during the Airdrop+ event. The exact duration of the fee waiver is subject to the details displayed on the trading page.
  • • Completion status for the Spot Trading Challenge will not be displayed on the event page. Trading volume is automatically recorded and verified by the system.

Futures Trading Challenge

  • • Participants must complete at least Primary KYC Verification before the end of the event to be eligible for rewards.
  • • Only users who meet the minimum Futures trading volume requirement will qualify for the corresponding reward tier. Users who do not meet the minimum threshold will not be ranked or eligible for any rewards.
  • • After the event ends, the system will automatically rank participants based on their valid Futures trading volume. In the case of identical trading volumes, rankings will be determined by the time the trading volume was first reached.
  • • Rewards for the lowest tier will be distributed based on each user's proportion of valid Futures trading volume relative to the total volume within that tier. A maximum reward cap applies to each user. Please refer to the event details for specific limits.
  • • Valid Futures trading volume includes the participant's total trading volume (open positions + close positions) in USDT-M, USDC-M, and USDE-M Perpetual Futures, as well as copy trading and grid trading volume (excluding stablecoin Futures such as USDCUSDT). Only trading volume that incurs non-zero fees during the event period will be counted. Trading volume that uses fee vouchers will not be included.
  • • The completion status of the Futures Trading Challenge will not be displayed on the event page. All trading volumes are automatically recorded and verified by the system.

Referral Rewards

  • • Referees must complete their sign-up during the event period for the referral to be deemed valid. Referrals involving referees who signed up before the event started will not be counted toward the event's referral statistics, and the referrer will not be eligible to receive the corresponding reward.
  • • Referred users must complete the New User Tasks, which includes making a net deposit of $100 in any token and trade Spot or Futures to qualify for the reward.
  • • Referrers participating in this event do not have to register.

General

  • • Convert volume are also counted towards eligible Spot tasks, with volume calculated as the USDT equivalent of the source token (the "from" token) based on the most recent 1-hour closing price of the source token/USDT pair. Only conversions to and from the event token qualify.
  • • Token rewards denoted in USDT equivalent (e.g., $50,000 in token X) are calculated based on the token's average daily price in USDT during the event. Daily Average Price = Daily Traded Volume (in USDT) / Daily Traded Quantity. The average price for the event period represents the mean of all daily average prices, with each day defined as the 24-hour period from 16:00 (UTC) to 16:00 (UTC) on the following day.
  • • Rewards will be issued within 10 calendar days after the event ends. All rewards are issued on a first-come, first-served basis while supplies last. Token rewards will be airdropped to users' Spot accounts. Futures bonuses (valid for 14 days) will be issued to Futures accounts and can be used as margin. Profits made with bonuses are withdrawable.
  • • This event does not constitute investment advice. Participation in this event is entirely voluntary.
  • • All participating users must strictly abide by the MEXC Terms of Service. MEXC reserves the right to disqualify any participants who engage in dishonest or abusive activities during the event, including bulk-account registrations to farm additional bonuses and any other activities in connection with unlawful, fraudulent or harmful purposes.
  • • MEXC reserves the right to modify the terms of this event without prior notice.
  • • MEXC reserves the right of final interpretation for this event. If you have any questions, please contact the Customer Service team.
